# Blind spots of this method, named rather than assumed:
#  - the run-time computed.*/health.* family is absent here: this container has no
#    resolved configuration, so the definition catalog is empty. producerOf() resolves
#    that family through the catalog (ChannelUniverse.php:150), not through this map.
#  - a violationCode emitted but never declared would not appear; that gap is covered
#    by ChannelEmissionStaticGuardTest / ChannelCoverageTest, not by this table.
#  - SARIF also emits non-channel descriptors (QMX-ANALYSIS-* notifications), which are
#    built in SarifFormatter, not in SarifRuleCollector, and are out of scope here.
